surface: First-person practice range. The proposed finish is not implemented. Existing debug HUD is the runtime test surface.
main_view: From Hero Hub toward Brawling Arena and the two cyan drone tracks; red targets and sandstone floor, violet high ground, green rescue station. No canonical hero portrait or weapon invented.

layout.top_right: compact drill statistics, hits / shots and allies revived / 4
layout.center: small high-contrast crosshair; no persistent text over targets
layout.lower_center: one context-sensitive action with current binding, e.g. X Revive ally
layout.lower_right: precision state; LT Aim, RT Fire, Menu Controls only as needed

variants: precision: reduced field of view and fine aim; no target automatically acquired
near rescue pod: show interaction glyph
first visit: show hints; experienced player: fade hints, planned

states.loading: Hide counters until telemetry is ready
states.empty: Hits 0/0; accuracy shown as dash rather than dividing by zero
states.disconnected: Clear held actions and show reconnect/keyboard notice
states.settings: D-pad selects and adjusts, A or Menu saves, B cancels; keep gameplay actions suppressed

art: 4:3 studio board, obsidian and violet-black framing, thin lavender rules and ivory type. In-play panels remain quiet and readable. Use shape and text as well as colour. Board: concept, not runtime footage.
future_not_implemented: Hero-specific ability mappings, health, resources and cooldowns after playable kits exist
independent paddle support where exposed or platform-level mapped paddles
full analog-to-digital navigation/remapping and selectable HUD scale/safe zone
physical_acceptance: Real Xbox pad over USB and Bluetooth; identify model, host and game commit
navigate from range to settings and back without mouse; rebind, restart and confirm prompts
track a low and high drone; verify fine aim near center, full turn and no creep at rest
fully and partially press each trigger independently and together; verify no double shot
disconnect while moving, firing, aiming and editing settings; reconnect and verify neutral
check readability from a TV and capture genuine uncut controller run
image_archive: pending exact generated bytes and owner review
runtime_evidence: Use commit-specific Godot CI logs and viewport media; generated board never qualifies as proof of hardware or runtime.
